# Final checklist against the assignment guide

This version is intended to cover the remaining guide items after the Case-II optimizer was made valid.

## Implemented / generated by `main.py`

Run:

```bash
python main.py --case both --no-open-plots
```

This produces:

- Case-I optimized solution.
- Case-II optimized resonant Earth-flyby solution.
- PCA comparison for Case I.
- Case-I vs Case-II delta-v comparison.
- Numerical validation at `R_B` against tighter tolerances.
- State-variable plots for the optimized cases.
- Numerical-error plots for Case I.
- Distance plots `r(t)` and `|r(t)-R_Earth(t)|`.
- Heliocentric 2D trajectories.
- Earth-centered 2D trajectories.
- Osculating orbital elements relative to the Sun and relative to Earth.
- Heliocentric GIF animations for Case I and optimized Case II.

If GIF generation is slow on your PC, use:

```bash
python main.py --case both --no-open-plots --skip-animations
```

For faster testing of the numerical results only:

```bash
python main.py --case both --skip-plots --no-open-plots
```

## Notes for the report

- Resonances below 1:12 are energetically too weak for Earth-Saturn with the two-impulse Case-II architecture.
- A closer or more energetic flyby does not automatically minimize total fuel: it can increase post-flyby energy but worsen the arrival velocity direction and increase `dv_fin`.
- Case III with a mid-course impulse at the flyby periapsis is not part of the required assignment and should only be presented as an optional extension.
